rationale: The Latin anchors *pittacium* (patch/piece of material), *commissura* (joint/seam), and *lamina* (thin sheet/plate of metal) all point firmly to a flat sheet or piece of metal/material, matching plate.n.02 ("a sheet of metal or wood or glass or plastic"). The sense of a flat, thin piece used as a patch or covering aligns with the OE clút (patch, piece of cloth or metal), not with any food-related or geological sense of "plate."
